children: Canadian women's fashion retailer Aritzia has a long-term growth trajectory that is being overshadowed, according to UBS. The analysts say "while investors are increasingly focused on comp sales normalization as the company laps last year's mobile app launch, we believe the market is underappreciating the durability of Aritzia's growth algorithm." Growth potential is supported by U.S. whitespace, digital growth and margin expansion, the analysts say. They forecast around 15% revenue growth and about 26% EPS CAGRs through 2030. "We believe this growth profile positions ATZ as a niche compounder that should continue to outperform within Specialty Retail, justifying a premium valuation." Aritzia is down 0.9% at C$126.93, and up 8% year-to-date. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
